facts.statement: Country is inferred from the visitor's browser time zone rather than IP address, so VPNs don't change the reported country, though a few time zones are missing or shared across borders and can mistag some visitors.

provenance.quote: Country is derived from the visitor's browser time zone (IANA time zone database), not their IP address, so VPNs don't affect it. Almost every country is covered, but a few time zones are missing from our mapping or shared across borders, so some visitors may be tagged under the wrong country.

facts.statement: Simple Analytics tracks utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and utm_content, but has deprecated utm_term because it may contain user data; custom ref= and source= parameters are saved as utm_source.

provenance.quote: We track utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, and utm_content. The utm_term parameter is deprecated as it may contain user data. Custom parameters like ref= and source= are also saved as utm_source.

facts.statement: The product is positioned both as a standalone GA4 replacement and as a second, consent-independent count run alongside GA4 to reveal a consent gap.

voice.tone: Matter-of-fact and reassuring; explains constraints and policy in plain cause-and-effect terms without hedging or hype. No superlatives, no urgency language — just 'this is how it works and why.'

exemplars: Simple Analytics is designed to operate without processing personal data. As a result, a Data Processing Agreement is not required in most cases.

We understand that some organizations require a DPA as part of their procurement process. We support this and will review and sign customer-provided agreements, provided they align with how the service operates.

We don't collect, store, or process personal data. That fundamentally reduces risk. Traditional analytics tools collect large amounts of user-level data, which increases both complexity and risk. Simple Analytics takes a different approach by avoiding the collection of personal data altogether.

Our free plan offers unlimited pageviews. This allows you to track as much traffic as your website gets without any restrictions. However, we have a fair use policy to make sure our servers run smoothly for all users. If your traffic exceeds our fair use limits, we'll notify you via email. If you're unsure about your website's traffic volume, feel free to [contact us](https://dashboard.simpleanalytics.com/contact) in advance.
Run Simple Analytics alongside GA4 for 30 days, free. We help you set it up and compare the numbers.
